# ITGmania whole-song archives

This directory contains content-addressed `.tar.zst` archives for captured
simfiles in the `lua-songs` corpus. `index.json` maps each complete capture's
source simfile to its archive SHA-256. The full corpus audit and remaining
charts are recorded in [remaining-charts.md](remaining-charts.md) and
[capture-report.json](capture-report.json).

Every archive contains:

- `manifest.json` with schema versions, ITGmania source revision, display and
  update context, random-state provenance, texture metadata, required assets,
  and hashes for every member;
- `song/` with the simfile, reachable Lua closure, and locally referenced assets;
- `trace/semantic.json` with the complete native semantic/render trace.

The Rust test opens these files from disk and stream-decompresses them. It does
not use `include_bytes!`, launch ITGmania, or depend on the external `lua-songs`
directory after extraction.

The 2026-10-07 addition contains ten previously uncovered songs, bringing the
index to 56 archives. Each capture completed through the chart endpoint with
no native runtime errors or dropped events:

- `1035/1035.sm`
- `321STARS/321STARS.ssc`
- `99+ [-YOSEFU-]/99+.ssc`
- `A Op.01/A Op.01.ssc`
- `ACCENDIO/aCCENDIO.ssc`
- `Abraham's OP/Abraham's OP.ssc`
- `Accelerator/Accelerator.ssc`
- `Actin Up/actinup-fakemines.ssc`
- `Aegleseeker/Aegleseeker.ssc`
- `Afterburn/Afterburn.ssc`

These fixtures were generated by `itgmania-harness-rs` against ITGmania revision
`5b205125ad53b9867bb4a494ff858f8d38ad4406`, using both dance-single players,
Challenge-preferred chart selection, an 854x480 display, and 60 Hz updates.
Archive and member hashes were checked; DeadSync fixture tests were not run.

To regenerate this subset, copy the unchanged song directories into a temporary
corpus, retaining only the listed simfiles and all their Lua and asset files.
From `itgmania-harness-rs/`, use separate temporary trace and archive directories:

```powershell
.\target\debug\itgmania-harness-rs.exe song-lua-semantic-baseline $subset `
  --out $traces --beat-step 0.25 --max-events 500000 --random-seed 1
.\target\debug\itgmania-harness-rs.exe song-lua-archive ..\lua-songs `
  --traces $traces --out $archives
```

Copy the generated archives here and merge their index entries by
`source_simfile`, preserving unrelated entries. The archive command writes an
index for its supplied subset, so generate into a temporary output directory
before merging. Baseline updates require an intentional native recapture and
review of the recorded reference revision and content hashes.

Validate all archive hashes and members:

```powershell
cargo test --test song_lua_itgmania_semantic_parity `
  whole_song_archive_index_and_streamed_members_are_valid
```

Run full compilation, full-duration composition, and exact trace comparison for
one chart:

```powershell
$env:DEADSYNC_SONG_ARCHIVE="Cuphead"
cargo test --test song_lua_itgmania_semantic_parity `
  whole_song_archives_compile_compose_and_match_native_trace -- `
  --ignored --nocapture
```

Unset `DEADSYNC_SONG_ARCHIVE` to audit the complete corpus. The full audit is
ignored by default because it is intentionally expensive and reports real
remaining parity gaps; archive integrity stays in the normal test suite.
